session_summary: Blue title bar: 'Bear Trend Reversal' (filename phrases it 'consective parabolic wedge tops and bear trend reversal'; title-map had called this reversal_day - the on-chart title is more precise: reversal INTO a bear trend, so trend_reversal_to_bear). Reading: opening recovery from 3145 lows, consecutive parabolic bull wedges (magenta dotted lines) lifting to 3171 by 08:15, breakdown from 08:35, midday retest range 3157-3166 with magenta drawn wedge, 'Wedge DT' at 3165.5 (10:10-10:45) that broke down, sell climax + DB at the 3157 green dotted support (10:35) whose bounce failed as a second leg, then bear trend to 3142 by 12:40 and a final chop 3137-3140. Axis prints 07:00-13:00 with day markers 7/7 -> 7/8 (offset-style, not plain PT); 2020-vintage Covid-era low, signal boxes only, no bar numbers.
